_about: Scout's weekly report: what's hot inside services people already pay for. Real, dated, sourced picks only. At most one pick per service per week. Refresh weekly (checked 2026-11-18, Wednesday run).

items.title: "Taken: Natalee Holloway" is still Netflix's #1 English show
items.text: 7.2 million views in the week of Nov 9, its second week on top of the English TV list. It's already in your Netflix plan.

items.title: "BbY WOW" by KAROL G, Judeline and rusowsky is #1 on Spotify worldwide
items.text: About 33 million streams in the week of Nov 12, top of the Spotify Global weekly chart. Free to play with your Spotify plan.
items.src: Spotify Global weekly chart via Soundcharts, week of Nov 12, 2026

items.title: "Percy Jackson and the Olympians" season 3 lands this Friday
items.text: Two-episode premiere on Friday, Nov 20, with new episodes on Nov 27 and after. Included with Disney+.
items.src: Laughing Place, Everything coming to Disney+ in November 2026

items.title: "Way of the Warrior Kid" movie arrives Nov 25
items.text: Apple TV's new action-drama movie comes out Wednesday, Nov 25, just in time for the holiday weekend. It's already in your Apple TV plan.
items.src: 9to5Mac, Everything new on Apple TV in November 2026
